one_line: Answer a how-did-I-make-it question with a screen recording of the real order steps, price included, then the kids' reaction.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 blurred shot of two children (about 5 to 6) on an armchair with an open book; focus settles at 0:01 and they laugh. From 0:01, text: "איך יצרתי לאחיינים שלי ספר שמספר בול עליהם?" No speech.
q1_hook.why: A how-did-I-make-this question over two delighted children and the finished book gives the result before the method (H5, H2). The headline is up by 0:01 (T3). But the very first frame is a blur and there is no voice, so the hook works only by reading (H7, H4).

beats.what: Two children laugh over an open book on an armchair; the question text from 0:01
beats.why: Real delight plus an open question

beats.what: Static close-up of the cover with a polaroid of two illustrated children; no text
beats.why: Shows what the finished product looks like

beats.what: Phone screen recording: Google search, catalogue with prices, red arrow; "חיפשתי בגוגל זיקית ספרים"
beats.why: Shows where to find it, so the viewer can follow

beats.what: Product page: 184 ש"ח, 32 pages, ages 0 to 8, printed in Israel
beats.why: Answers price and spec doubts early

beats.what: Wizard: age, first name, eye and hair colour, accessories; "ואז עונים על כמה שאלות"; the cover picture changes
beats.why: The personalising act, with a live-updating picture

beats.what: Preview scrolls through the pages; "ותוך דקה יש לי ספר מותאם אישית בול בשבילם!"
The children read the printed book; spark text "הם עפו על התוצאה!"; an inside spread
beats.why: A real reaction after the process

beats.what: Cover upright against a wall; label "זיקית ספרים מותאמים אישית"

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "מה דעתכםן?", a vague what-do-you-think. Nothing in the video asks for a comment, send or save.
q2_flow.why: The opening question is answered step by step, so the loop closes at 0:33 to 0:39 (H5, K2). The 31 s recording changes screens every 2 to 5 s, but with no voice and small text it asks the viewer to read for half a minute (R3, R1). The children return as the payoff (R4).

q3_cta.what: None in the video except the sign-off label "זיקית ספרים מותאמים אישית" (0:45). Caption: "מה דעתכםן?" and a link, "https://zikit.me/". No code, no comment word.
q3_cta.why: The video ends on a brand label with no ask, and the link is only in the caption (C6). The caption holds two different asks, a reply and a click (C1). "מה דעתכםן?" is vague, not a specific question a parent can answer from their life (C5).

q4_shown.what: Two children reading the book 0:01-0:05 and 0:39-0:43; the cover with a polaroid of illustrated children; a phone screen recording 0:07-0:38: Google search, catalogue, product page with "184 ש"ח", the character wizard, the page preview; an inside spread; the cover upright.
q4_shown.why: The wizard, with a picture that updates as choices are made, shows personalising and its result (S8). A price is shown, but the line about delivery under it is too small to read (S3). No real photo sits beside the illustration, the main doubt (S2). Children's faces and typed first names go against S5.

q5_edit.what: 12 shots in 47 s, about 3.9 s each. The middle 31 s is one phone screen recording with black side bars, text overlays and an added red arrow. Hard cuts; a slide transition with black frames at 0:42-0:43. No speed changes seen.
q5_edit.why: A moderate pace (E2), and the recording changes screens every few seconds (R3). The black side bars look unfinished (F1). The first real change is a cut at 5.3 s (E1). It ends on a short label with no dead tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: How an aunt ordered a twins book for her nephews, step by step, with the price. It serves relatives and parents asking how ordering works.
q6_topic.why: A relative buying for children is a clear buyer (K7). Practical facts, price and steps, arrive next to the children's joy, which is information with emotion (K4, K1). The question-to-result path is a small story (K2).

q7_filmed.what: A static medium shot of two children on a balcony armchair in daylight, focus pulled at 0:01; a static close-up of the cover against a wall with a fox height chart; a phone screen recording; a close-up of an open spread. No creator face.
q7_filmed.why: Daylight, a home balcony and a screen capture look native and sharp (H8, F7). The children's faces are shown only in a medium shot, not close at the peak (K8). The screen recording sits with black side bars (F1).

q8_text.on_screen: Opening question on white strips, about 63% down: "איך יצרתי לאחיינים שלי ספר שמספר בול עליהם?" (0:01). White text with a black outline over the recording, 2 to 3 lines: "חיפשתי בגוגל זיקית ספרים ונכנסתי לאתר" (0:07), "אפשר להוסיף אפילו משקפיים וכיפה!" (0:28), "ותוך דקה יש לי ספר מותאם אישית בול בשבילם!" (0:33), spark text "הם עפו על התוצאה!" (0:39), label "זיקית ספרים מותאמים אישית" (0:45, bottom).
q8_text.caption: "סרטון שצילמתי וערכתי ל @zikitbooks האלופים! 🦎". Three short lines: that credit, "מה דעתכםן? 😇", and a link. No hashtags, no code, no paid-partnership label.
q8_text.why: All message in text, so it works muted (T1), headline in the first second (T3). Outlined text covers the fields being shown (T2); the label sits near the bottom edge (T4). Caption: no search words or hashtags (T7); "filmed and edited for" is no disclosure word (T8).

weak_points: 31 s of small-text screen recording with no voice; a blurred first frame; a vague caption question; no CTA in the video; no real photo beside the cover; no disclosure word.
lumebook_takeaway: Open with a how-did-I-make-this question over the finished book, then screen-record the order steps in short text steps and show the price with delivery; end on the book.
not_verified: The audio, music or none, as the transcript is only "תודה רבה". Whether the children are the nephews, and whether the typed first names are theirs. The delivery line under the price is unreadable. The black frames at 0:42-0:43 may be a transition or a glitch. 720 x 1280 is the downloaded copy. Correction to coded file: the question text starts at 0:01, not in the blurred first frame. The cover and wizard carry first names, not quoted.
